status: Seven installed structures. Native placement in four rotations, support, under-deck transport, water retention/spill parity and walking passed main 90; exact save/reload and six walking destinations passed 91. Eight concrete platform size/height variants are authored and export-checked; native placement untested. Three concrete side platforms (legless decks hung beside a reinforced dam block) are authored; native placement untested. Fifteen steel structures (cantilevers 10/12/15, truss bridges 8/10/12/15, stackable columns 1-6 high, corner-supported decks 3×3 and 5×5) are authored and export-checked; native placement untested. Initial cost balance; steel structures carry heavy High-Grade Steel and Concrete costs pending the cost rework.

legDecks.$comment: Placement tools, never entities: each places the named deck plus one stack of steel columns per deck foundation (SteelDeckToolSpec, src/DeepFrontier/Scripts/SteelStructures). clearance = deck layers above the pointed surface; columns are listed by height; maxDepth = longest leg below the deck.
